title: Legs Boost
description: Full legs and core workout: squats, Bulgarian split squats and dynamic plank in 2 blocks

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot side to side

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width apart, lower until thighs are parallel to the floor

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squats
exercises.instructions: Back foot on a chair, lower the knee

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, push hips toward the ceiling

exercises.name: Hollow hold
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, arms and legs extended above the floor, lower back pressed down

exercises.name: Russian twists
exercises.instructions: Seated, feet off the floor, rotate torso left and right

exercises.name: Flutter kicks
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs extended, rapid alternating kicks

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
